lines.text: Professional programmers spend most of their time organising code. Procedures are their most important tool.
A procedure is a named, reusable piece of code.
In Scratch it’s a My Block: you define it once and call it whenever you need it.
The input name in the define hat is a parameter.
The value you give when you call it is an argument: polygon (5) passes 5 as sides.
A parameter only exists inside its define script.
That keeps procedures independent and safe to reuse.
Call a new procedure with a few arguments (3, 4, 10) before using it inside bigger programs.
In Python, def defines a procedure, called a function. sides is the parameter; 3 and 6 are arguments.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
